SampBuildAdministratorsSet()
Source: samlogon.cxx
Get the list of DS Objects that are directly or transitively a member of any group on this list. Transitivity through distribution groups is applicable here.
Members must be in the same domain as the PDCe this process runs on.
All security principals are included.
